about:
Central Park Apartments NYC provides apartments for rent in New York at 19 West 103rd Street in Manhattan's Upper West Side. Located just a 15-minute walk from Columbia University. Fordham University Lincoln Center and Barnard College can be accessed by subway in 15 minutes. Our studios in Central Park Inn at 19 W 103rd St are carefully designed and furnished to feel cozy and welcoming. For your convenience, the apartments come with high-speed Wi-Fi, weekly housekeeping, and flexible lease options. This extended stay in New York is also adjacent to Central Park, offering a peaceful and scenic environment perfect for residents. 
 
Features 
There are generous amenities at Central Park Inn NYC at 19 West 103rd Street for you to enjoy:
Fully Equipped Kitchen: Electric stovetop, microwave, toaster, coffee maker, and mini‑fridge 
Comfort spaces: Double-size bed, Flat‑screen TV with cable, High‑speed Wi‑Fi, individually controlled air conditioning, and Private Bathroom
Thoughtful Touches: Generous closet space, dedicated work desks, blackout curtains, and plush towels
 
Central Park Inn isn't just about private studios. It also offers a handful of communal spaces and services in these extended stays to make your stay both social and effortless:
Weekly Cleaning Service
Enjoy a thorough weekly clean of your studio, including fresh towels and linens furnished for every visit.
24‑Hour Reception 
Friendly staff at the front desk in Central Park Apartments NYC are on duty around the clock.
Security
The apartment has CCTV cameras that keep your safety.
High-speed Wi‑Fi 
The high‑speed Wi‑Fi keeps you connected across the apartments.
 
The surroundings of Central Park Inn NYC
Our spaces at 19 West 103rd Street are perfect for international visitors, students, interns, digital nomads, and those looking for extended stays. 
Prime Upper West Side Location
Only 2 minutes from Central Park, you'll also find world-class museums like the Natural History Museum and Lincoln Center near Central Park Apartments NYC at 19 West 103rd Street. Also, you can discover the cozy coffee shops and local favorites.
Easy Commute
From Central Park Inn, just a 1-minute walk to the B and C subway lines, you can easily access other boroughs within quick reach.

about: Union Square Apartment at 209 E 14th St, New York, NY 10003, offers a prime living experience in one of Manhattan’s most vibrant and well-connected neighborhoods. Situated just steps from Union Square Park, this residence provides unparalleled access to shopping, dining, entertainment, and major subway lines, making it an ideal choice for students, professionals, and city lovers alike. The apartments feature modern interiors with spacious layouts, large windows for ample natural light, and contemporary finishes. Each unit is designed for both comfort and functionality, boasting fully equipped kitchens with stainless steel appliances, sleek cabinetry, and elegant countertops. Additionally, residents can enjoy well-appointed living spaces, with select units offering private balconies that overlook the bustling cityscape. Beyond the apartments, the building offers a range of amenities to enhance the urban living experience. Residents have access to secure entry, on-site laundry facilities, and package receiving services, ensuring both convenience and security. The neighborhood itself is a major attraction, with Whole Foods, Trader Joe’s, top-rated restaurants, and cultural hotspots just minutes away. Transportation is seamless, with immediate access to the 4, 5, 6, L, N, Q, R, and W subway lines, making commutes to other parts of Manhattan and beyond quick and effortless. Whether you're a student at NYU, The New School, or Baruch College, or a professional working in Midtown or Downtown, this location offers the ultimate convenience. With its prime location, modern amenities, and vibrant surroundings, Union Square Apartment at 209 E 14th St provides an exceptional living experience in the heart of New York City.
